info.title: Remindora API
info.description:
REST API for Remindora — tasks, projects, calendar, focus, habits, collaboration, priority notifications and device linking.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. Realtime events are delivered over Socket.IO at `/realtime` (auth: `{ token }`).

Errors use `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`. Plan limits return **402** with `code: plan_limit | plan_feature`.
